quotes.text: SetSyntaxError(true, "cannot advance beyond end of fLineOfTokens")

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Malformed IMAP responses can pass pointers outside the tokenizer buffer. Validate offsets and paren-group state at runtime and mark a syntax error; an assertion alone does not prevent invalid pointer movement or a crash.
title: Enforce IMAP tokenizer bounds in release builds
